High Protein Magic Shell Yogurt (Peanut Butter Chocolate)

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by

Instaread

If you’re a peanut butter chocolate lover, this magic shell yogurt is about to become your go-to. It’s a high protein dessert or snack (or maybe even breakfast, no judgment) that tastes indulgent but is actually just Greek yogurt, peanut butter, a little sweetener, crushed cookies, and a thin chocolate shell. The absolute best part of this dish (besides how it tastes) is that you get to crack into with a spoon. It comes together in about 5 minutes of prep time, with the hardest part being the wait time for the shell to harden.

This is the recipe I reach for when I want something that feels like dessert but doesn’t derail the day. It’s creamy, crunchy, chocolatey, and genuinely fun to eat because of that satisfying crack when you break through the shell.

Why You'll Love This Magic Shell Yogurt

  • High protein: thanks to Greek yogurt and peanut butter, this is a dessert you can feel good about.
  • Easy and simple: five ingredients, no baking, no fuss.
  • Indulgent without the calorie hit: it satisfies a peanut butter chocolate craving without a huge calorie load.
  • Fun to eat: cracking the chocolate shell with a spoon is half the appeal.
  • Customizable: swap the cookies, the peanut butter, or the sweetener to fit what you have on hand.

Ingredients

  • Plain Greek yogurt
  • Peanut powder (or regular peanut butter)
  • Honey or maple syrup, plus more to taste
  • Oreo cookies, crumbled
  • Melted chocolate
  • Crushed peanuts

  • A note on peanut powder: I like using powdered peanut butter here because it blends smoothly into the yogurt with no streaks and keeps the texture light. Regular peanut butter works too, just stir it in well.

  • A note on cookies: Oreo Thins are my pick because they crumble finely and keep the layer thin, but regular Oreos, any cookie you like, or graham crackers all work great as the filling.

How to Make Magic Shell Yogurt

STEP 1

In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, peanut powder (or peanut butter), and honey until well combined. Taste and add more sweetener if you’d like it sweeter. Fold in the crumbled cookies.

STEP 2

Pour the melted chocolate over the top and use a spoon or spatula to spread it into a thin, even layer. Sprinkle with crushed peanuts.

STEP 3

Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for the best texture.

Tips for the Best Magic Shell Yogurt

  • Spread the chocolate thin. A thick layer is harder to crack cleanly and easier to overdo on calories.
  • Chill it flat so the chocolate sets in an even layer across the top.
  • If you’re short on time, the freezer can speed up hardening, but the fridge gives the best texture for the yogurt underneath.
  • Make it your own: swap peanut butter for almond or cashew butter, or use dark chocolate for the shell.

Storage

  • Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. The chocolate shell stays crackable, though it softens slightly the longer it sits.

High Protein Magic Shell Yogurt

This magic shell yogurt is a high protein dessert that's ready in minutes. Crack through a chocolate shell into creamy peanut butter Greek yogurt for an indulgent, satisfying snack without a ton of calories.
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 5 minutes mins
2 hours hrs
Total Time 2 hours hrs 5 minutes mins
Course Breakfast, Dessert, Snack
Cuisine American
Servings 1 person

Ingredients
  

  • 3/4 cup plain Greek yogurt
  • 2 tbsp peanut powder or 2 tbsp regular peanut butter
  • 2 tsp honey or maple syrup plus more to taste
  • 3 Oreo cookies crumbled
  • 1/3 cup melted chocolate
  • 2 tbsp crushed peanuts
Get Recipe Ingredients

Instructions
 

  • In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, peanut powder (or peanut butter), and honey until well combined. Taste and add more sweetener if you'd like it sweeter. Fold in the crumbled cookies.
  • Pour the melted chocolate over the top and use a spoon or spatula to spread it into a thin, even layer. Sprinkle with crushed peanuts.
  • Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for the best texture.
  • Once the chocolate has fully hardened, crack through the shell with a metal spoon and scoop out the yogurt underneath. Enjoy.

Notes

Notes: Swap Oreo Thins for regular Oreos, any cookie, or graham crackers. Regular peanut butter can replace peanut powder.
